blocks.text: P-pop groups SB19, BINI, BGYO, and HORI7ON scored major victories at Brazil’s BreakTudo Awards 2026, held in São Paulo on Tuesday, Nov. 24. SB19 and BGYO led the Filipino contingent with two trophies each during the annual ceremony. READ: BINI, SB19 celebrate historic Grammy nominations SB19 claimed the International Male Group award. They also won International Collaboration of the Year for “Emoji,” their joint track with Taiwanese pop star Jolin. Meanwhile, BGYO took home the Asian Artist honor.
